entities.summary: The Social Democratic Party of Albania is a minor social democratic political party in Albania. Its founder is Skënder Gjinushi, a former Minister of Education (1987–1991) and Speaker of Parliament (1997–2001). Its current chairman is Deputy Tom Doshi. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
